rtt_slots: For a five-person team, adopting microservices brings disproportionate operational complexity compared to the organizational scaling benefits the architecture is intended to provide. The coordination costs imposed by this pattern—such as defining service boundaries, setting up distributed tracing, and maintaining independent deployment pipelines—will directly compete with the product iteration velocity essential for early-stage survival. A properly modularized monolith allows you to keep your options open. Boundaries already embedded in the codebase can be extracted later, once the expansion of the team topology actually becomes necessary.
